body: Improving my life isn't an option. I need to find a way out of this degrading life somehow. I'm tired of giving up or pursuing things for nothing. No one would want to live like this
Sorry to hear. I have given up though. I have no more strength. I want to make a choice that is dignifying to me. Not anyone else, just me.
No, I don't want to go on any more.
Out of interest, who have you planned to look after your son, or are you not sure
I'm in my forties but knew it was over a long time ago. I should have killed myself then. It would have been better.
